medium: cut-out photo collage on white grid paper with yellow marker marks, close photographs of money, paper maps; yellow-highlighted serif headline text, small sans subtitles
avoid: illustration, cartoon, vector icons, 3D render, gradients, dark backgrounds, text baked into the image
note: No presenter. Two videos are the same film in Arabic and English (sheets 0 and 3). Hook lines are a yellow-highlighted serif - our serif-highlight caption look; body captions are a small centred sans at the bottom. Chrome 3D lettering and the founder cut-out are never generated.

looks.label: Cut-out collage on grid paper
looks.when: an idea, a step, a thing in the story - shown as a photo cut-out on paper with yellow marker marks.
looks.prompt: A scrapbook collage on white paper with a faint grey grid: the subject as a photograph cut out by hand with a thin white paper border, placed off-centre with plenty of empty paper around it; beside it two or three quick yellow marker strokes - a squiggle, an underline or a rough outline sketch in the same yellow. Flat photographed paper, soft shadow under the cut-out, no words.

looks.label: Money photographed close
looks.when: money itself - a banknote, cash, gold, a bill, printing, a vault.
looks.prompt: A close photograph of money: engraved banknote detail, fanned hundred-dollar bills, or banded stacks of cash on a polished table, shallow focus, real paper texture and ink, warm neutral light, sometimes one yellow marker underline drawn across the photo. No words added.

looks.label: Paper map
looks.when: a country, a region, a border, money moving from one place to another.
looks.prompt: A printed political map of the region, pastel country colours with thin borders and small black place names, filling the frame edge to edge, photographed flat like a paper map with slight paper texture; no added labels.

looks.label: Hook line on blue sky
looks.when: the opening hook question or a section title - the words go on an empty sky.
looks.prompt: A bright clear blue sky filling the frame with one small white cloud low in the frame and the top edge of a modern building along the very bottom; nothing else, the upper two thirds left empty for a caption.

looks.label: 3D chrome lettering
looks.when: words as 3D chrome calligraphy - never generated, the models cannot letter.

looks.label: Person cut-out on paper
looks.when: a real person as a cut-out - never generated.
